name: hh-helper-ext
description: Firefox extension: shows vacancy response counters that hh.ru already sends to the browser

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint -s dist --self-hosted
scripts.start: npm run build && web-ext run -s dist --url https://hh.ru/search/vacancy?text=python
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist -a web-ext-artifacts -n hh-helper-ext.xpi --overwrite-dest
